topic: The student asks if the tutor ever gets tired or sick of answering questions all day long.
core_question: The user is pushing the assistant to admit it feels fatigue or boredom from its job.
persona: skeptical and testy; texting quickly with typos here and there

messages.content: do u ever get tired or sick of answering questions all day long

like dont u get bored? all day just questions. u must get tired of it
